title: Color picker closes abruptly when updating image from an exported color setter
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible from 4.3 dev 6 onward. Master too
Not reproducible in 4.3 dev 5 and earlier, git bisect found that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88690 was the commit that introduced this issue.

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.14 GiB memory - WASAPI (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I've created an extended class of ImageTexture which purpose it to let me easily create simple textures without leaving the editor. A while ago (4.3 dev6) the behavior changed. As soon as I edit a color of the ImageTexture (See code below) the color picker closes, making it really annoying to use. It also changes the color without committing anything to undo/redo.

It's just now that I've decided to make an issue since I wanted to try and fix it myself as a first PR, and I have a few solutions but they all have their drawbacks. **I will create a PR for one of them soon.**

What's causing it:
- When calling `set_image` or `update`, `notify_property_list_changed` gets run, causing the inspector tree to be rebuilt and thus destroying the color picker popup.
- The same behavior is also observed in resources like ArrayMesh.

I previously mentioned this in another issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109367, the freezing got fixed but the closing that I mentioned there too didn't (which is understandable, and why I'm creating this separate issue now)

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP and try editing the `color` field of the `CustomTexture` resource that's exported from the root node.

Or, use this code and create a node that exports the type `CustomTexture`
```
@tool
class_name CustomTexture extends ImageTexture

var img = Image.create(50,50,false,Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)

# Editing this closes the color picker
@export var color:Color = Color.WHITE:
	set(value):
		color = value
		img.fill(color)
		set_image(img)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Colorpicker.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32739519/Colorpicker.zip)
